verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents one accelerator-specific program: a resource library packaged for Techstars members and a 50% discount code (TECHSTARS) on its Extraordinary Ability Bootcamp course. This is direct evidence of an accelerator tie-in with community pricing, but it covers a single accelerator and the discount applies only to a course, not to its legal packages. missing for 10: documented formal partnership terms beyond Techstars (e.g., YC or other accelerators), VC-portfolio arrangements, founder-community discounts on core legal and visa packages, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing

citations.quote: You can sign up to Founder Law’s Extraordinary Ability Bootcamp course for 50% off with the code: TECHSTARS
